verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents employer-side sponsorship as a distinct service. It helps employers secure H-1B and other work visas [docs-13], handles transfers for employees changing employers [docs-15], and guides employers through the annual cap and lottery registration [docs-16]. It prepares and maintains LCAs and Public Access Files to Department of Labor requirements [docs-19], plus self-audits, training, and worksite-change policies [docs-18, docs-20, docs-21] and extension and amendment tracking [docs-14]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the employer service, and in-depth process or pricing detail beyond marketing-level page descriptions.
